```{r}
log10macspv = as.numeric(sub("^[A-Za-z]+", "", prefix))
if (is.na(log10macspv)) log10macspv = 10
```



# feat with `macs3` (`thres=1e-`r log10macspv ``)

This section defines the genomic coordinates used throughout the analysis.


```{r peaks, results="verbatim"}
# #	Nom de la colonne	Description	Type / Exemple
# 1	chrom	Nom du chromosome	chr1
# 2	chromStart	Position de début du pic (0-based, inclusif)	3455000
# 3	chromEnd	Position de fin du pic (1-based, exclusif)	3455500
# 4	name	Nom du pic	peak_00001
# 5	score	Score de 0 à 1000 (utile pour visualisation UCSC)	500
# 6	strand	Brin (+, -, ou . si non applicable)	.
# 7	signalValue	Enrichissement du signal au sommet du pic	12.45
# 8	pValue	–log10(p-value) de la significativité du pic	7.30
# 9	qValue	–log10(q-value, FDR ajustée)	5.21
# 10	peak	Position du sommet du pic par rapport à chromStart (en bp). -1 si inconnu.	250
feat = read.table(paste0("macs3_output_merged/mrg1.00e-", log10macspv, "_peaks.narrowPeak"))
rownames(feat) = feat[,4]
colnames(feat) = c("chrom", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "name", "score", "strand", "signalValue", "pValue", "qValue", "peak")
feat = feat[nchar(feat$chrom)<=5,]
head(feat)
dim(feat)

# debup feat according to locus (chr:end-start)
feat$key = paste0(feat[[1]], ":", feat[[2]], "-", feat[[3]])
length(unique(feat$key))
feat = feat[!duplicated(feat$key),]
length(unique(feat$key))

# peaks len
feat$len = feat$chromEnd - feat$chromStart
```

```{r peaks_hm, fig.height=6}
# Stat feat
custom_hm(feat$qValue , feat$pValue     , xlab="qValue", ylab="pValue     ", LOGCOUNT=TRUE, main=prefix)#, xlim=c(0, quantile(feat$qValue, .99), ylim=c(0, quantile(feat$pValue     , .99))))
custom_hm(feat$qValue , feat$signalValue, xlab="qValue", ylab="signalValue", LOGCOUNT=TRUE, main=prefix)#, xlim=c(0, quantile(feat$qValue, .99), ylim=c(0, quantile(feat$signalValue, .99))))
custom_hm(feat$len    , feat$signalValue, xlab="len   ", ylab="signalValue", LOGCOUNT=TRUE, main=prefix)#, xlim=c(0, quantile(feat$len   , .99), ylim=c(0, quantile(feat$signalValue, .99))))
custom_hm(feat$len    , feat$qValue     , xlab="len   ", ylab="qValue     ", LOGCOUNT=TRUE, main=prefix)#, xlim=c(0, quantile(feat$len   , .99), ylim=c(0, quantile(feat$qValue     , .99))))
```
